[PotatoLock Corrigido 16-10.html](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33568308/PotatoLock.Corrigido.16-10.html)
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Editor de gameinfo.gi para Deadlock</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Nunito:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');
:root{
  --bg:#0a0d10;
  --bg-2:#0e1217;
  --pn:#13171c;
  --pn2:#1a1f26;
  --ln:#252d37;
  --tx:#c9d1d9;
  --tx-2:#8b949e;
  --mu:#6e7681;
  --br:#3DC9FF;
  --br-2:#1ea8e0;
  --br-3:#7ddcff;
  --br-glow:rgba(61,201,255,.18);
  --wh:#ffffff;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
  --rd:14px;
  --rd-sm:10px;
  --rd-lg:18px;
  color-scheme:dark;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}[hidden]{display:none!important}
html,body{text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body{
  margin:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 80% -10%, rgba(61,201,255,.06), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(900px 500px at -10% 10%, rgba(61,201,255,.04), transparent 60%),
    var(--bg);
  color:var(--tx);
  font:15px/1.55 'Nunito',ui-rounded,'SF Pro Rounded','Inter',system-ui,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  letter-spacing:.1px;
}
header,main{max-width:1140px;margin:auto;padding:0 24px}
header{padding-top:8px}
.wd{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 22px}
h1{
  font:800 clamp(30px,5.2vw,46px)/1.05 'Nunito',ui-rounded,'SF Pro Rounded','Inter',sans-serif;
  margin:42px 0 10px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--wh) 0%,var(--br) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  letter-spacing:-.5px;
}
h2{
  font:700 17px/1.3 'Nunito',ui-rounded,'SF Pro Rounded','Inter',sans-serif;
  margin:0;color:var(--wh);letter-spacing:.2px;
}
p.s{color:var(--tx-2);margin:0;max-width:72ch;font-size:14.5px}
.rule{
  height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--br),transparent 80%);
  opacity:.6;margin:22px 0 30px;
  transform-origin:left;animation:draw 1.1s var(--ease) both;
  border-radius:1px;
}
.cs{animation:rise .55s var(--ease) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--d,0)*1ms)}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}}
@keyframes draw{from{transform:scaleX(0)}}
@keyframes grow{from{transform:scaleY(0)}}
@keyframes sweep{0%{opacity:.35}100%{opacity:0}}
@keyframes pulseGlow{
  0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 var(--br-glow)}
  50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(61,201,255,0)}
}
.stp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:46px 1fr;gap:16px;position:relative;padding-bottom:30px}
.stp::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:22px;top:50px;bottom:4px;width:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--ln),transparent);
  transform-origin:top;animation:grow .9s var(--ease) both;
  animation-delay:calc(var(--d,0)*1ms + 250ms);
  border-radius:2px;
}
.stp.l::before{display:none}
.n{
  width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:16px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:var(--pn2);
  border:1.5px solid var(--ln);
  color:var(--br);
  font:800 17px 'Nunito',sans-serif;
  transition:all .3s var(--ease);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03);
}
.done .n{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--br),var(--br-2));
  border-color:transparent;
  color:#05263a;
  font-size:0;
  box-shadow:0 4px 18px -6px var(--br-glow);
}
.done .n::after{content:"\2713";font-size:20px;font-weight:800}
.b{min-width:0}.b>h2{margin:10px 0 12px}
.pan{
  background:var(--pn);
  border:1px solid var(--ln);
  border-radius:var(--rd);
  padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px;
  box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.02) inset;
}
.bar{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:10px;align-items:stretch;
}
.bar > b{
  grid-column:1 / -1;
  font:800 14px 'Nunito',sans-serif;
  color:var(--wh);
  letter-spacing:.3px;
  margin-bottom:2px;
}
button,.fl{
  font:inherit;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--tx);
  background:var(--pn2);
  border:1px solid var(--ln);
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:11px 16px;
  min-height:44px;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:all .22s var(--ease);
  position:relative;
  line-height:1.3;
  white-space:normal;
  text-align:center;
  font-size:14px;
}
button:hover:not(:disabled),.fl:hover{
  border-color:var(--br-2);
  background:var(--pn);
  transform:translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:0 6px 20px -10px var(--br-glow);
}
button:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(0) scale(.985)}
button.pri{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--br) 0%,var(--br-2) 100%);
  color:#042233;
  border-color:transparent;
  font-weight:800;
  box-shadow:0 6px 22px -10px rgba(61,201,255,.55),0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.15) inset;
  letter-spacing:.2px;
}
button.pri:hover:not(:disabled){
  box-shadow:0 10px 28px -10px rgba(61,201,255,.7),0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.2) inset;
  transform:translateY(-1.5px);
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--br-3) 0%,var(--br) 100%);
}
button.on{
  background:rgba(61,201,255,.1);
  border-color:var(--br-2);
  color:var(--br-3);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(61,201,255,.25);
}
button.on:hover:not(:disabled){
  background:rgba(61,201,255,.15);
}
button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed;filter:grayscale(.3)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--br);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}
.fl{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border-style:dashed;border-width:1.5px;
  padding:24px 20px;width:100%;text-align:center;
  color:var(--tx-2);font-weight:600;
  border-radius:var(--rd);
}
.fl:hover{background:rgba(61,201,255,.04);border-color:var(--br-2)}
.fl.ov{
  border-color:var(--br);
  background:rgba(61,201,255,.08);
  color:var(--br-3);
  animation:pulseGlow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
#st{display:block;color:var(--tx-2);font-size:13px;margin-top:10px;font-weight:500}
#q{
  width:100%;font:inherit;font-weight:500;
  color:var(--tx);
  background:var(--pn);
  border:1px solid var(--ln);
  border-radius:var(--rd-sm);
  padding:11px 14px;margin:0 0 14px;
  transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s,background .2s;
}
#q::placeholder{color:var(--mu);font-weight:500}
#q:focus{
  outline:none;
  border-color:var(--br-2);
  background:var(--pn2);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--br-glow);
}
#adbox > b,
.bar > b{
  display:block;
  font:800 14px 'Nunito',sans-serif;
  color:var(--wh);
  letter-spacing:.3px;
  margin-bottom:12px;
}
#adl{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:12px;margin:0 0 14px;
}
@media(max-width:680px){#adl{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.ad{
  display:flex;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;
  padding:14px 16px;min-height:86px;
  background:var(--pn2);
  border:1px solid var(--ln);
  border-radius:14px;
  transition:all .22s var(--ease);
}
.ad:hover{
  border-color:var(--br-2);
  background:var(--pn);
  transform:translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
.ad:has(input:checked){
  border-color:var(--br);
  background:rgba(61,201,255,.08);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--br-glow),0 8px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
.ad input{accent-color:var(--br);margin-top:4px;flex:none}
.ad b{display:block;color:var(--wh);font-weight:800;font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:3px}
.ad small{display:block;color:var(--tx-2);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5}
.note{display:block;color:var(--tx-2);font-size:13px;max-width:82ch;font-weight:500}
.b > .bar,
.b > #adbox,
.b > #q,
.grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr;
  max-width:760px;
  margin-left:auto;
  margin-right:auto;
}
.b > .bar,
.b > #adbox{
  width:100%;
}
.grid{
  gap:16px;align-items:start;
}
details.card{
  background:var(--pn);
  border:1px solid var(--ln);
  border-left:3px solid var(--ln);
  border-radius:var(--rd);
  transition:all .3s var(--ease);
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.02) inset;
}
details.card:hover{border-color:#2c3643}
details.card.lit{
  border-left-color:var(--br);
  box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.02) inset,-3px 0 20px -10px var(--br-glow);
}
summary{
  cursor:pointer;list-style:none;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:16px 18px;
  user-select:none;
}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
summary::after{
  content:"";width:8px;height:8px;
  border:solid var(--tx-2);border-width:0 2px 2px 0;
  transform:rotate(45deg);transition:transform .25s var(--ease);
  margin:-3px 2px 0 4px;
}
details[open]>summary::after{transform:rotate(-135deg);margin-top:3px;border-color:var(--br)}
.cnt{margin-left:auto;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--tx-2);font-weight:600}
.lit .cnt{color:var(--br)}
.o{
  position:relative;
  padding:12px 18px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--ln);
  transition:background .25s var(--ease);
}
.o::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:var(--br);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
}
.o.hit::after{animation:sweep .9s ease-out forwards;animation-delay:var(--f,0ms)}
.o:has(input[type=checkbox]:checked){background:rgba(61,201,255,.05)}
.o label{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;color:var(--tx)}
.o small{display:block;color:var(--tx-2);font-weight:500;font-size:12.5px;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.5}
input[type=checkbox]{
  appearance:none;flex:none;
  width:40px;height:22px;border-radius:999px;
  background:#2a333e;position:relative;
  margin:2px 0 0;cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .25s var(--ease),box-shadow .25s;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
input[type=checkbox]::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;
  width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#e6edf3;
  transition:transform .28s var(--ease),box-shadow .2s;
  box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
input[type=checkbox]:checked{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--br),var(--br-2));
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.2),0 0 0 3px var(--br-glow);
}
input[type=checkbox]:checked::before{transform:translateX(18px);background:#fff}
.r{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:10px 0 2px 52px;transition:opacity .3s}.r.off{opacity:.45}
.r output{
  min-width:66px;text-align:right;
  color:var(--br);
  font-weight:800;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  font-size:13.5px;
}
input[type=range]{
  flex:1;appearance:none;height:7px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--br) var(--p,0%),#2a333e var(--p,0%));
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  transition:box-shadow .2s;
}
input[type=range]:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 0 0 3px var(--br-glow)}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  appearance:none;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#d7e3ec);
  border:2.5px solid var(--br);
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s;
}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover{transform:scale(1.12)}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#fff;border:2.5px solid var(--br);
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
.pvw{margin:8px 0 20px}.pvw>summary{padding:0 0 12px}
pre{
  background:var(--bg-2);
  border:1px solid var(--ln);
  border-radius:var(--rd);
  padding:16px;overflow:auto;max-height:360px;
  font-size:12.5px;color:#b6c2cc;
  white-space:pre;margin:0;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,'SF Mono','Cascadia Code',Consolas,monospace;
  line-height:1.6;
}
.w{
  border-left:3px solid var(--br);
  padding:10px 14px;
  background:rgba(61,201,255,.05);
  color:var(--tx-2);font-size:13px;margin:0;
  border-radius:0 var(--rd-sm) var(--rd-sm) 0;
  font-weight:500;
}
.wd{margin-bottom:20px}.wd>summary{padding:0 0 12px}
.actions{margin:10px 0 44px}
.actions .bar.pan{
  max-width:100%;
  border:1px solid var(--br-2);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--br-glow) inset,0 12px 40px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
  padding:16px;
  border-radius:var(--rd-lg);
}
.pan.import{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(61,201,255,.06),transparent 70%),var(--pn);
  border:1px solid rgba(61,201,255,.25);
  border-radius:var(--rd);
  padding:16px;
}
.pan.import h2{
  font:800 16px 'Nunito',sans-serif;
  color:var(--wh);
  letter-spacing:.2px;
}
@media(max-width:980px){
  .actions .bar{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));justify-content:stretch}
}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .actions .bar{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:460px){
  .actions .bar{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

details#customize{
  grid-column:1 / -1;
  background:var(--pn);
  border:1px solid var(--ln);
  border-left:3px solid var(--br);
  border-radius:var(--rd);
  margin-top:6px;
  overflow:hidden;
  transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s;
  box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.02) inset,-3px 0 20px -10px var(--br-glow);
}
details#customize > summary{
  list-style:none;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:14px 18px;
  font:800 15px 'Nunito',sans-serif;color:var(--wh);
  letter-spacing:.2px;user-select:none;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(61,201,255,.06),transparent 80%);
}
details#customize > summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
details#customize > summary::after{
  content:"";width:9px;height:9px;margin-left:auto;
  border:solid var(--br);border-width:0 2.5px 2.5px 0;
  transform:rotate(45deg);transition:transform .25s var(--ease);
  margin-top:-2px;
}
details#customize[open] > summary::after{transform:rotate(-135deg);margin-top:4px}
details#customize > summary ._cnt{
  margin:0 0 0 auto;padding-right:10px;
  font-size:13px;color:var(--br);font-weight:700;
}
details#customize ._inner{
  padding:10px 16px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);
  display:grid;gap:12px;
}
footer{padding:6px 0 28px}
code{
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,'SF Mono','Cascadia Code',Consolas,monospace;
  font-size:12.5px;
  background:var(--pn2);
  padding:2px 6px;
  border-radius:6px;
  border:1px solid var(--ln);
  color:var(--br-3);
  font-weight:500;
}
.b > .bar,.b > #adbox,.grid{max-width:none;margin-left:0;margin-right:0}
.wd{max-width:none;margin:0 0 22px}
.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,340px),1fr))}
#p2 .bar.pan{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
@media(max-width:680px){#p2 .bar.pan{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
details#customize > summary ._cnt{margin-left:auto}
details#customize{margin:0 0 14px}
#msg{grid-column:1 / -1;min-height:1.2em;margin-top:2px}
#p1 .pan.import{margin-bottom:0}
#st{overflow-wrap:anywhere}

/* Correção do painel de ações: o auto-fit com minmax(0,1fr) comprimia
   os botões em colunas estreitas, fazendo os textos se sobreporem. */
.actions .bar.pan{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  align-items:stretch;
  gap:10px;
}
.actions .bar.pan > b{
  flex:0 0 100%;
  width:100%;
  margin:0 0 4px;
}
.actions .bar.pan > button{
  flex:1 1 180px;
  min-width:150px;
  width:auto;
  min-height:46px;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  z-index:1;
}
.actions .bar.pan > #msg{
  flex:0 0 100%;
  width:100%;
}
@media(max-width:520px){
  .actions .bar.pan > button{flex:1 1 100%;min-width:0}
}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
@media(max-width:520px){
  header,main{padding:0 16px}
  .n{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:13px}
  .stp{grid-template-columns:40px 1fr}
  .stp::before{left:19px}
}
</style></head><body>
<header>
<h1 class="cs">Editor de gameinfo.gi – Deadlock</h1>
<p class="s">Escolha um preset (ou personalize), opcionalmente selecione um pacote de addons, importe o seu gameinfo.gi existente e gere a versão modificada. Tudo roda no seu navegador; nada é enviado pela internet.</p>
<div class="rule"></div>
</header>
<main>
<details class="wd"><summary><h2>Leia antes de usar</h2></summary>
<div class="w">Coloque o arquivo baixado em <code>Deadlock/game/citadel/</code>, substituindo o antigo (guarde uma cópia do original). Cada patch do jogo sobrescreve o arquivo: basta carregar o novo e aplicar o preset de novo. A Valve já indicou que convars alteradas no gameinfo.gi podem ser restringidas no matchmaking no futuro, e remover neblina ou aumentar o FOV dá vantagem de visibilidade. O uso é por sua conta e risco. Não existe opção para o tamanho da fonte do dano: ela não é controlada por este arquivo. Os addons (VPK) trocam materiais e texturas do jogo por versões simplificadas; o pacote PotatoLock é o mais agressivo e deixa o visual bem feio. Todos os pacotes também substituem o som de parry (pak01) e um layout do hideout (pak03). Se você já usa outros mods em <code>addons/</code> com nomes <code>pak01_dir.vpk</code>…<code>pak04_dir.vpk</code>, eles serão sobrescritos. Para desinstalar, apague esses arquivos da pasta addons e use "Restaurar original" (ou escolha "Nenhum" e instale de novo).</div>
</details>
<div class="stp cs" id="p1" style="--d:120">
<div class="n">1</div>
<div class="b"><h2>Importar o arquivo do jogo</h2>
<div class="pan import">
<h2 style="margin:0 0 12px">Importar seu gameinfo.gi</h2>
<label class="fl" id="drop"><input type="file" id="f" accept=".gi,.txt" hidden><span>Escolher arquivo ou soltar aqui</span></label>
<span id="st">Nenhum arquivo carregado. Ele fica em …/steamapps/common/Deadlock/game/citadel/</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="stp cs" id="p2" style="--d:220">
<div class="n">2</div>
<div class="b"><h2>Escolher preset e addons</h2>
<div class="bar pan"><b>Preset</b>
<button data-p="qual" title="Reduz partículas e sombras, mantendo visual agradável e fiel">Qualidade</button>
<button data-p="des" title="Remove partículas, sombras, decals e detalhes meramente estéticos para FPS mais alto e melhor visibilidade">Desempenho</button>
<button data-p="potato" title="Remove tudo que for estético e substitui texturas — jogo extremamente leve">PotatoLock</button>
<button id="customize-open" title="Abre as opções detalhadas já expandidas">Personalizar</button>
</div>
<details id="customize">
<summary>Opções detalhadas<span class="_cnt" id="cuz-cnt"></span></summary>
<div class="_inner">
<input type="search" id="q" placeholder="Filtrar opções (ex.: neblina, sombra, fps)" aria-label="Filtrar opções">
<div class="grid" id="g"></div>
</div>
</details>
<div class="pan" id="adbox"><b>Pacotes de addons (VPK)</b>
<div id="adl"></div>
<span class="note">Cada pacote tem 4 arquivos (<code>pak01_dir.vpk</code> a <code>pak04_dir.vpk</code>) que vão em <code>Deadlock/game/citadel/addons/</code>. Ao escolher um pacote, o editor também inclui <code>Game citadel/addons</code> no SearchPaths do gameinfo.gi e as linhas <code>Mod</code>/<code>Write</code> de <code>citadel</code> e <code>core</code> (se ainda não existirem). Desde a atualização de 29/09/2026 o arquivo original da Valve não traz mais essas linhas, e sem elas o jogo fecha com o erro “Unable to read default keybinding configuration (user_keys_default)”. Todos os arquivos já estão embutidos nesta página.</span>

["farfield","Sombras e luz","Sem distance field distante","","r_citadel_distancefield_farfield_enable=0"],

["lod","Desempenho","Escala de LOD","Menor = modelos mais simples. Muito baixo gera buracos nos modelos.","sc_screen_size_lod_scale_override={v}",[0.4,1,0.05,0.6,""]],

const AI={
 Profissional:["Profissional","Visual limpo para competitivo: remove decals, overlays e cartas de vegetação (209 materiais) e usa texturas padrão neutras. O mais leve em alterações (~1 MB)."],
 Streamer:["Streamer","Mesma base do Profissional, mas com mais materiais simplificados (1097), incluindo panos e outros detalhes. (~4,6 MB)"],
 PotatoLock:["PotatoLock","Otimização extrema: 2546 materiais e 741 texturas substituídos (inclui texturas de heróis). Para PCs muito fracos. (~15 MB)"]};
let AD=null;
const S={};let text=null,fname="gameinfo.gi";
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
// interface
const g=$("g");
function fileOk(){$("dl").disabled=$("rs").disabled=false;$("p1").classList.add("done")}
function curP(n){document.querySelectorAll("[data-p]").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on",b.dataset.p===n))}
function grp(){document.querySelectorAll(".cnt").forEach(c=>{const l=O.filter(o=>o[1]==c.dataset.c),k=l.filter(o=>S[o[0]].on).length;
  c.textContent=k?k+" de "+l.length+" ativas":l.length+" opções";c.parentNode.parentNode.classList.toggle("lit",k>0)})}
const _up=up;up=function(){_up();grp()};
[...new Set(O.map(o=>o[1]))].forEach((gr,gi)=>{
 const s=document.createElement("details"),l=O.filter(o=>o[1]==gr);s.open=true;s.className="card cs";s.style.setProperty("--d",450+gi*90);
 s.innerHTML='<summary><h2>'+gr+'</h2><span class="cnt" data-c="'+gr+'"></span></summary>';
 l.forEach((o,ri)=>{
   S[o[0]]={on:false,v:o[5]?o[5][3]:0};
   const d=document.createElement("div");d.className="o cs";d.dataset.id=o[0];d.dataset.r=ri;d.style.setProperty("--d",550+gi*90+ri*30);
   let h='<label><input type="checkbox" id="c_'+o[0]+'"><span>'+o[2]+(o[3]?'<small>'+o[3]+'</small>':'')+'</span></label>';
   if(o[5])h+='<div class="r off" id="r_'+o[0]+'"><input type="range" id="s_'+o[0]+'" min="'+o[5][0]+'" max="'+o[5][1]+'" step="'+o[5][2]+'" value="'+o[5][3]+'"><output id="v_'+o[0]+'"></output></div>';
   d.innerHTML=h;s.appendChild(d);
   d.querySelector("input[type=checkbox]").onchange=e=>{S[o[0]].on=e.target.checked;sync(o[0]);curP(null);up()};
   const sl=d.querySelector("input[type=range]");if(sl)sl.oninput=e=>{S[o[0]].v=+e.target.value;S[o[0]].on=true;sync(o[0]);curP(null);up()};
  });g.appendChild(s)});
$("q").oninput=e=>{const q=e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
 g.querySelectorAll(".o").forEach(d=>d.hidden=!!q&&!d.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q));
 g.querySelectorAll(".card").forEach(c=>{const any=[...c.querySelectorAll(".o")].some(d=>!d.hidden);c.hidden=!any;if(q&&any)c.open=true})};
const adl=$("adl");
[[null,"Nenhum","Não instala nem referencia addons."],...Object.keys(AI).map(k=>[k,AI[k][0],AI[k][1]])].forEach(([k,n,d],i)=>{
  const l=document.createElement("label");l.className="ad cs";l.style.setProperty("--d",350+i*80);
  l.innerHTML='<input type="radio" name="ad" value="'+(k||"")+'"><span><b>'+n+'</b><small>'+d+'</small></span>';
  l.querySelector("input").onchange=()=>{AD=k;setAd(k);up()};adl.appendChild(l)});
function setAd(k){AD=k;document.querySelectorAll("input[name=ad]").forEach(r=>r.checked=(r.value||null)===k);$("zp").disabled=!k}
setAd(null);
const dz=$("drop");
["dragover","dragenter"].forEach(t=>dz.addEventListener(t,e=>{e.preventDefault();dz.classList.add("ov")}));
["dragleave","drop"].forEach(t=>dz.addEventListener(t,e=>{e.preventDefault();dz.classList.remove("ov")}));
dz.addEventListener("drop",e=>{const f=e.dataTransfer.files[0];if(f){const dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(f);$("f").files=dt.files;$("f").dispatchEvent(new Event("change"))}});
const disp=(o,v)=>{const u=o[5][4];return o[4].includes("{p}")?2**v+" "+u:v+u};
function sync(id){const o=O.find(x=>x[0]==id),s=S[id];$("c_"+id).checked=s.on;
  if(o[5]){const sl=$("s_"+id);sl.value=s.v;sl.style.setProperty("--p",((s.v-o[5][0])/(o[5][1]-o[5][0])*100)+"%");$("v_"+id).textContent=disp(o,s.v);$("r_"+id).classList.toggle("off",!s.on)}}
function preset(n){const p=P[n],ch=[];if("ad" in p)setAd(p.ad);
  O.forEach(o=>{const s=S[o[0]],x=p[o[0]],was=s.on+"|"+s.v;s.on=x!==undefined;s.v=(typeof x=="number"&&o[5])?x:(o[5]?o[5][3]:0);sync(o[0]);if(was!==s.on+"|"+s.v)ch.push(o[0])});
  curP(n);up();
  if(document.body.classList.contains("go")){let k=0;g.querySelectorAll(".o").forEach(d=>{d.classList.remove("hit");
    if(ch.includes(d.dataset.id)){d.style.setProperty("--f",(k++*45)+"ms");void d.offsetWidth;d.classList.add("hit")}})}}
setTimeout(()=>{document.body.classList.add("go");g.querySelectorAll(".o").forEach(d=>d.style.setProperty("--d",d.dataset.r*30));g.querySelectorAll(".card").forEach(c=>c.style.setProperty("--d",0))},2400);
// geração
function entries(){const m=new Map(),sp=[];
 O.forEach(o=>{const s=S[o[0]];if(!s.on)return;
  const a=(2.15+(s.v-90)*.03).toFixed(2);
  o[4].split(";").forEach(x=>{
   if(x.startsWith("SP::")){sp.push({line:x.slice(4),l:o[2]});return}
   let[k,...r]=x.split("=");let v=r.join("=").replace("{v}",s.v).replace("{a}",a).replace("{p}",2**s.v),sec=null;
   if(k.includes("."))[sec,k]=k.split(".");m.set((sec||"")+"|"+k,{sec,k,v,l:o[2]})})});
 if(AD)sp.push({line:"Game\t\t\tcitadel/addons",l:"Addons: "+AD});
 return{cv:[...m.values()],sp}}
const ST="// >>> GIM START (gerado pelo Editor de gameinfo.gi)",EN="// <<< GIM END";
function block(eol){const e=entries().cv,L=[ST];
 e.filter(x=>!x.sec).forEach(x=>L.push('\t\t"'+x.k+'" "'+x.v+'" // '+x.l));
 e.filter(x=>x.sec).forEach(x=>L.push("\t\t// "+x.sec+"."+x.k+" = "+x.v+" (editado direto na seção "+x.sec+")"));
 L.push(EN);return L.join(eol)}
const MW=[["Mod","citadel"],["Write","citadel"],["Mod","core"],["Write","core"]];
const MWC=" // obrigatório desde a atualização de 29/09/2026";
const reSP=(k,v)=>new RegExp('^\\s*"?'+k+'"?\\s+"?'+v+'"?\\s*(//.*)?$','i');
function spBlock(eol){const sp=entries().sp,L=[ST];
 sp.forEach(x=>L.push("\t\t"+x.line+" // "+x.l));
 if(AD)MW.forEach(([k,v])=>L.push("\t\t"+k+"\t\t\t"+v+MWC));
 L.push(EN);return L.join(eol)}
function fixSP(L,addAd,addMW){
 let r=secR(L,"SearchPaths");if(!r)throw new Error("Seção SearchPaths não encontrada.");
 const ind=l=>((l||"").match(/^\s*/)||[""])[0]||"\t\t";
 if(addAd){let idx=-1;for(let i=r[0]+1;i<r[1];i++)if(reSP("Game","citadel").test(L[i])){idx=i;break}
  if(idx<0)idx=r[0]+1;
  L.splice(idx,0,ST,ind(L[idx])+"Game\t\t\tcitadel/addons // Addons: "+AD,EN);r=secR(L,"SearchPaths")}
 if(addMW){const body=L.slice(r[0]+1,r[1]),miss=MW.filter(([k,v])=>!body.some(l=>reSP(k,v).test(l)));
  if(miss.length){let at=-1;
   for(let i=r[0]+1;i<r[1];i++)if(/^\s*Game\s+"?core"?\s*(\/\/.*)?$/i.test(L[i]))at=i;
   if(at<0)for(let i=r[0]+1;i<r[1];i++)if(/^\s*Game\s/i.test(L[i]))at=i;
   const pos=at<0?r[1]:at+1,d=ind(at<0?L[r[0]+1]:L[at]);
   L.splice(pos,0,ST,...miss.map(([k,v])=>d+k+"\t\t\t"+v+MWC),EN)}}}
function secR(L,n){for(let i=0;i<L.length;i++){if(L[i].trim().replace(/"/g,"")!==n)continue;let j=i+1;while(j<L.length&&!L[j].trim())j++;if(!L[j]||L[j].trim()!=="{")continue;let d=0;
 for(let k=j;k<L.length;k++){const l=L[k].replace(/\/\/.*$/,"");d+=l.split("{").length-l.split("}").length;if(d===0)return[j,k]}}return null}
function clean(t){const eol=t.includes("\r\n")?"\r\n":"\n";let L=t.split(/\r?\n/),o=[],skip=false;
 for(const l of L){if(l.trim()===ST.trim()){skip=true;continue}if(skip){if(l.trim()===EN)skip=false;continue}
  let m=l.match(/^(\s*)\/\/\[GIM\] ?(.*)$/);if(m){o.push(m[1]+m[2]);continue}
  m=l.match(/^(\s*"?\w+"?\s+)("[^"]*"|[^\s/]+)(.*?)\s*\/\/\[GIM:(.*)\]\s*$/);
  if(m){if(m[4]!=="__NONE__")o.push(m[1]+m[4]+m[3]);continue}o.push(l)}
 return o.join(eol)}
function build(){const c=clean(text),eol=c.includes("\r\n")?"\r\n":"\n",L=c.split(/\r?\n/),e=entries();
 for(const x of e.cv.filter(x=>x.sec)){const r=secR(L,x.sec);if(!r)continue;
  const re=new RegExp('^(\\s*"?'+x.k+'"?\\s+)("[^"]*"|[^\\s/]+)(.*)$');let ok=false;
  for(let i=r[0]+1;i<r[1];i++){const m=L[i].match(re);if(m){L[i]=m[1]+x.v+m[3]+" //[GIM:"+m[2]+"]";ok=true;break}}
  if(!ok)L.splice(r[0]+1,0,'\t\t"'+x.k+'" "'+x.v+'" //[GIM:__NONE__]')}
 const hasAd=/^\s*Game\s+"?citadel\/addons"?\s*(\/\/.*)?$/m.test(c);
 if(AD||hasAd)fixSP(L,!!AD&&!hasAd,true);
 const r=secR(L,"ConVars");if(!r)throw new Error("Seção ConVars não encontrada.");
 const keys=new Set(e.cv.filter(x=>!x.sec).map(x=>x.k));
 for(let i=r[0]+1;i<r[1];i++){const m=L[i].match(/^(\s*)"([^"]+)"\s/);if(m&&keys.has(m[2]))L[i]=m[1]+"//[GIM] "+L[i].trim()}
 if(keys.size||e.cv.filter(x=>x.sec).length)L.splice(r[0]+1,0,...block(eol).split(eol));
 return L.join(eol)}
function up(){const e=entries(),n=e.cv.length+e.sp.length;
 $("pv").textContent=n?(e.sp.length?spBlock("\n")+"\n\n":"")+(e.cv.length?block("\n"):""):"(nada selecionado: o arquivo gerado ficará igual ao padrão)";
 $("cuz-cnt").textContent=n?`${n} ativos`:""}
function save(name,data){const a=document.createElement("a");a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data],{type:"text/plain"}));a.download=name;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),2000)}
// eventos
document.querySelectorAll("[data-p]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>preset(b.dataset.p));
$("customize-open").onclick=()=>{const d=$("customize");d.open=true;d.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"})};
document.querySelectorAll(".lang__list button").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
  const fl=b.dataset.flag,lb=b.dataset.label;
  const sum=$("lang").querySelector("summary");
  sum.querySelector(".lang__flag").textContent=fl;
  $("lang-label").textContent=lb;
  $("lang").removeAttribute("open");
});
$("f").onchange=async e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;const t=await f.text();
 if(!/GameInfo/i.test(t)||!secR(t.split(/\r?\n/),"ConVars")){$("st").textContent="Este não parece ser um gameinfo.gi válido (seção ConVars não encontrada).";return}
 text=t;fname=f.name;fileOk();
 $("st").textContent=f.name+" carregado ("+t.split(/\r?\n/).length+" linhas)"+(t.includes(ST.trim())?" – já continha ajustes deste editor; eles serão substituídos.":".")+(/^\s*Game\s+"?citadel\/addons/m.test(t)&&!MW.every(([k,v])=>t.split(/\r?\n/).some(l=>reSP(k,v).test(l)))?" ⚠ Este arquivo tem addons sem as linhas Mod/Write (causa do erro user_keys_default). Ao gerar de novo, elas serão adicionadas.":"")+(/^\s*Game\s+"?citadel\/addons/m.test(clean(t))?" O SearchPaths já tem citadel/addons.":"")};
$("dl").onclick=()=>{try{save("gameinfo.gi",build())}catch(x){alert(x.message)}};
$("rs").onclick=()=>save("gameinfo.gi",clean(text));
$("cp").onclick=async()=>{try{const e=entries(),t=(e.sp.length?spBlock("\n")+"\n\n":"")+(e.cv.length?block("\n"):"");await navigator.clipboard.writeText(t);$("msg").textContent="Bloco copiado."}catch(x){$("msg").textContent="Não foi possível copiar; selecione a prévia manualmente."}};
// ---- addons: descompactar, zip, instalar
async function inflate(h){const b=Uint8Array.from(atob(BL[h]),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
 const s=new Blob([b]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("deflate-raw"));return new Uint8Array(await new Response(s).arrayBuffer())}
async function packFiles(k){const out=[];for(const[n,hh,len]of PK[k]){const d=await inflate(hh);if(d.length!==len)throw new Error("Arquivo corrompido: "+n);out.push({name:n,data:d})}return out}
const CT=(()=>{const t=[];for(let n=0;n<256;n++){let c=n;for(let k=0;k<8;k++)c=c&1?0xEDB88320^(c>>>1):c>>>1;t.push(c>>>0)}return t})();
function crc(d){let c=-1;for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++)c=CT[(c^d[i])&255]^(c>>>8);return(c^-1)>>>0}
function mkzip(files){const enc=new TextEncoder(),P=[],C=[];let off=0,cs=0;
 for(const f of files){const n=enc.encode(f.name),c=crc(f.data),z=f.data.length;
  const a=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(30));a.setUint32(0,0x04034b50,true);a.setUint16(4,20,true);a.setUint16(6,0x800,true);a.setUint16(12,0x21,true);a.setUint32(14,c,true);a.setUint32(18,z,true);a.setUint32(22,z,true);a.setUint16(26,n.length,true);
  P.push(a.buffer,n,f.data);
  const b=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(46));b.setUint32(0,0x02014b50,true);b.setUint16(4,20,true);b.setUint16(6,20,true);b.setUint16(8,0x800,true);b.setUint16(14,0x21,true);b.setUint32(16,c,true);b.setUint32(20,z,true);b.setUint32(24,z,true);b.setUint16(28,n.length,true);b.setUint32(42,off,true);
  C.push(b.buffer,n);cs+=46+n.length;off+=30+n.length+z}
 const e=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(22));e.setUint32(0,0x06054b50,true);e.setUint16(8,files.length,true);e.setUint16(10,files.length,true);e.setUint32(12,cs,true);e.setUint32(16,off,true);
 return new Blob([...P,...C,e.buffer],{type:"application/zip"})}
async function wr(dir,name,data){const fh=await dir.getFileHandle(name,{create:true}),w=await fh.createWritable();await w.write(data);await w.close()}
$("zp").onclick=async()=>{if(!AD)return;try{$("msg").textContent="Gerando zip…";const f=await packFiles(AD);
 save("addons_"+AD+".zip",mkzip(f.map(x=>({name:"addons/"+x.name,data:x.data}))));$("msg").textContent="Zip gerado: extraia a pasta addons dentro de Deadlock/game/citadel/."}catch(x){alert(x.message)}};
$("ins").onclick=async()=>{
 if(!window.showDirectoryPicker){alert("Este navegador não permite gravar em pastas. Use Chrome ou Edge, ou então use os botões de download e copie os arquivos manualmente.");return}
 try{const root=await showDirectoryPicker({mode:"readwrite"});let cit=root;
  try{await cit.getFileHandle("gameinfo.gi")}catch{try{cit=await(await root.getDirectoryHandle("game")).getDirectoryHandle("citadel");await cit.getFileHandle("gameinfo.gi")}catch{alert("gameinfo.gi não encontrado. Escolha a pasta Deadlock/game/citadel (ou a pasta Deadlock).");return}}
  if(!confirm("Isto vai gravar o gameinfo.gi"+(AD?" e os 4 arquivos do pacote "+AD+" em addons/ (pak01 a pak04, sobrescrevendo os existentes)":"")+". Continuar?"))return;
  const cur=await(await(await cit.getFileHandle("gameinfo.gi")).getFile()).text();
  if(!/GameInfo/i.test(cur)||!secR(cur.split(/\r?\n/),"ConVars")){alert("O gameinfo.gi da pasta não parece válido.");return}
  const base=clean(cur);let hasBak=true;try{await cit.getFileHandle("gameinfo.gi.bak")}catch{hasBak=false}
  if(!hasBak)await wr(cit,"gameinfo.gi.bak",base);
  text=cur;$("msg").textContent="Gravando…";const out=build();
  if(AD){const ad=await cit.getDirectoryHandle("addons",{create:true});for(const f of await packFiles(AD))await wr(ad,f.name,f.data)}
  await wr(cit,"gameinfo.gi",out);
  fileOk();$("st").textContent="gameinfo.gi lido da pasta do jogo.";
  $("msg").textContent="Instalado"+(hasBak?"":" (backup salvo em gameinfo.gi.bak)")+". Reinicie o Deadlock."}
 catch(x){if(x.name!=="AbortError"){alert("Erro: "+x.message);$("msg").textContent=""}}};
O.forEach(o=>sync(o[0]));up();
</script></body></html>
